title: Kusanagi Nene — Who We Want To Be〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI
Harbor

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Is Robo-Nene gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. Thankfully, the dampener successfully broke her fall before impact, and all her servos seem to be functioning properly...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No major problems as far as I can tell.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank goodness☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Okay, your batteries are charged...
It should be okay for you to exit power-saving mode now.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Roger. Exiting power-saving mode.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I apologize for causing you all so much concern.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Robo-Nene, you're all better!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You deserve a pat on the back for the amazingly cool show you put on for us!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, that was awesome☆
You, Tsukasa and Rion went so high!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. We wouldn't have been able to get that map back without you! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, Robo-Nene, you totally stole the spotlight.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: No, I am glad that I was able to be of service.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
Also... This was a group effort.
We were able to retrieve that map because we all worked together.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All of us?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. We were able to succeed in the end because you all did what you could to make the plushies we met along the way smile.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Robo-Nene...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Including you, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...? Me?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. We would not have been able to cross that river if it were not for you.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, when we rode on that turtle's back?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. The truth is, when we first met that turtle, he was afraid of going into the water.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, he was?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. And Nene gave him the encouragement he needed to go back in the water.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No, I just...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also think what you did was significant, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I was very moved when you told our turtle friend about what you'd gone through.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You wanted him to hear the truth, and he listened. He understood what you were trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which allowed him to also be brave.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not you too, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that so...? I didn't realize that was how you got him to take us across on his back...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you, Nene!
I greatly appreciate your efforts!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, because we wouldn't have been able to meet Rion and that phoenix if you hadn't done that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
U-Uhh...
It was nothing, really...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's just... I saw my old self in him, so I couldn't just leave him be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your old self?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, because I was also once too afraid to try to move forward.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I realized something while doing shows with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's okay to be scared, but you gotta keep reminding yourself of the bigger picture.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Be brave, keep moving forward one step at a time, and your dream will eventually come true.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which...was what I wanted to tell him.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's also why I need to thank the both of you and Robo-Nene, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You two gave me the push I needed to tell that turtle about what I'd gone through.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, thank you both.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene & Luka
rows.Line:
You are welcome.
You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that our turtle friend heard you loud and clear.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Robo-Nene, everything seems to be operating normally since you exited power-saving mode.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes. All systems normal.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for doing maintenance on her, Rui.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course. I'm also glad to see that Robo-Nene is okay.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That being said, this could be a good opportunity to start working on a way to get Robo-Nene to actually fly since we still don't have a means of doing so.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sh-She's going to be able to fly?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! She's really gonna fly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. It's still just a possibility.
Needless to say, achieving flight won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But with the appearance of a new area in SEKAI, it could be the perfect time to give Robo-Nene a whole range of new functions and gadgets...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, no doing anything weird to her...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
In any case, I'm glad Robo-Nene's okay.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Me too...
Now, let's head back to the ship!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay☆

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Shall we, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm really glad I was able to help that turtle.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We were able to cross the river as a result, which led to us getting the map back...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I understand that you're scared.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm sure you'll get closer to achieving your dream if you find the courage to take the next step forward.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It ended up being a good reminder of how I really feel.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The fear that lingers inside me probably won't ever completely go away...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But that's not gonna stop me from moving forward...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Forward... Towards my hero, and my dream!)
